candidates.claim: rtr-01 defines an SNMP community in read-write mode (RW) with no ACL restriction, although management policy requires read-only communities restricted by an ACL that permits only MGMT hosts.
candidates.remediation: Remove the RW SNMP community on rtr-01, or change it to read-only and restrict it with an ACL that permits only 10.10.99.0/24 hosts (such as SNMP_NMS).
